meta.title: AI venue picks
meta.description: Describe the occasion, budget, party and district — the assistant will pick places and explain why it chose them.

page.badge: Demo AI · runs on mock logic
page.title: Tell us about the evening — we'll find the place
page.description: No need to scroll through dozens of cards. The assistant weighs cuisine, budget, party size, district and time — and explains every choice.
page.disclaimer: In this MVP the matching runs on a transparent scoring algorithm with no language model involved. The interface and API contract are ready for OpenAI — only the engine changes.

context.title: Understands context
context.text: Pulls cuisine, budget, party size, district and time out of a plain sentence.

explains.title: Explains its choice
explains.text: Shows how the match score adds up — and what might not work for you.

schedule.title: Checks opening hours
schedule.text: It won't suggest a place that's closed when you want to go.

freeInput.title: Describe the evening in your own words
freeInput.placeholder: Italian food, up to 10,000 ₸, 8 people, city centre, evening
freeInput.hint: The assistant will parse cuisine, budget, party size, district and time. You can also answer step by step below for a sharper result.

occasion.title: What's the occasion?
occasion.hint: The occasion sets the format: a date and a big celebration call for very different places.

cuisine.title: What kind of food?
cuisine.hint: Pick several — we'll look for places that serve at least one of them.
cuisine.categoriesLabel: Or choose a type of venue

budget.title: How much per person?
budget.hint: We'll show places that fit the amount. Slightly pricier ones too, but we'll say so upfront.

party.title: How many of you?
party.hint: From eight people we start including venues with banquet service.

place.title: Where and when?
place.hint: We'll check opening hours and only show places open at that time.

thinking.title: Finding places
thinking.subtitle: This usually takes a couple of seconds

steps.budget: Working out the budget for your party

empty.title: Nothing matches those conditions
empty.description: The budget or the area is probably too tight. Relax one condition and we'll find options.
